text: 🇲🇽🌎 "We don't want more tariffs — but any deal has to guarantee Mexico's wellbeing, our Constitution and our sovereignty." Sheinbaum says she is optimistic about a trade agreement with the US — but set the condition plainly: no meeting with Trump until there is a deal. — Claudia Sheinbaum Her principles are unchanged: sovereignty, independence, territorial integrity, non-intervention, non-subordination, coordination.

🇲🇽🏭 "Mexico's economy is doing very well — even with the tariffs." Inflation dropped to 3.12% in July. GDP grew 1.5% in the second quarter — despite US tariffs of 50% on steel and aluminum and 25% on autos. — Claudia Sheinbaum, 28 August 2026 Mexico still carries some of the lowest average export tariffs of any country in the world. Economy Minister Marcelo Ebrard is in Washington negotiating the tariffs down.

🇲🇽🔍 Homicides in Mexico are down 51% since Sheinbaum took office. Daily intentional homicides fell from 86.9 in September 2024 to 42.5 in July 2026. June 2026 was the lowest June for homicides since 2015. — Gobierno de México — security report The strategy: attention to root causes, youth education and jobs, a consolidated National Guard, and stronger intelligence and investigation. Results, not spin — three days before her Second Report.

🇲🇽📈 <u>Mexico's economy grew 1.4% last quarter — its strongest showing in years, tariffs and all</u>

INEGI data show GDP up 1.4% quarter-on-quarter and 1.9% annually in Q2 2026, the best quarterly print since early 2022, with all three sectors expanding and wholesale trade surging 11.3%. The growth landed despite Trump's tariff threats — El Financiero's own read: the economy is picking up in spite of the pressure from Washington.

🇲🇽♿ <u>48,756 people with disabilities in eastern Edomex now get a pension — paid directly, no middlemen</u>

Under the Plan Integral para el Oriente, 48,756 residents with permanent disabilities across Chalco, Nezahualcóyotl, Ecatepec and seven more municipalities receive 3,300 pesos every two months, deposited straight into Banco del Bienestar accounts — no brokers, no clientelist gatekeepers. It's part of a 75-billion-peso plan by Sheinbaum and Delfina Gómez to rebuild one of the country's most neglected regions.

🇲🇽🏫 <u>Money stolen by García Luna's network will now build schools in Guerrero</u>

Mexico recovered 5.8 million dollars from the Weinberg–García Luna corruption web, and the funds are headed to schools in Guerrero's impoverished Baja Montaña region. "Financial analysis let us reconstruct the network used to divert, triangulate and move resources between 2015 and 2017," said UIF chief Omar Reyes Colmenares. Cartel-era graft, poured back into classrooms.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>Mexico's oligarchs poured 2.7 billion pesos into 'philanthropy' — some of it aimed at the opposition</u>

A Contralínea investigation found 20 business-linked foundations — Coppel (575M), Diez Morodo (491M), FEMSA (290M) — moved 2.7 billion pesos in 2025, with a slice flowing to think tanks and groups fighting the Fourth Transformation. The report's finding is blunt: not all of it was charity, part was to finance opponents of the 4T. Familiar names like Claudio X. González sit at the center.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Lozoya's mansion now belongs to the Mexican people</u>

The Supreme Court threw out Emilio Lozoya's final appeal, making his 51-million-peso mansion in Lomas de Bezares property of the nation — a house the former Pemex director bought with bribe money from magnate Alonso Ancira and Odebrecht cash funneled through a shell company. The neoliberal looting is being reversed one seized property at a time.

🇲🇽💪 <u>Mexican wages just hit 30.8% of GDP — their biggest slice of the economy in decades</u>

INEGI reports worker pay climbed to 30.8% of Mexico's GDP in Q1 2026, up 4.1 points since 2018, as total labor income jumped 9.4% year-on-year to 10.9 trillion pesos. Six years of minimum-wage hikes are doing what four decades of neoliberalism only ever promised.
